name: Hoshizuki's Mother
source:
The mother of [url=https://vndb.org/c76033]Souma[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c74120]Ena[/url]. She is very busy with her work and often comes back late in the evening, just like her [url=https://vndb.org/c76036]husband[/url]. 

They think that their daughter are a quiet and kind girl and do not suspect she is actually an easy girl.
